description: Answer an introduction someone asked of your person. 'interested' means they are open to it and nothing more: contact is exchanged only when both sides choose to share, later and separately. 'not_now' declines. 'not_now_and_block' declines and stops these two cards being matched or introduced again. Two steps, and nothing is sent until your person approves the exact answer.

approved_digest.description: The approved_digest the preview returned, after the principal approved that exact content.

confirm.description: Send it. Requires approved_digest from the preview.
